widgets.chips.hdr.description: Chip shown for a few seconds in the corner of the picture when playback starts, and again when it changes: the picture is high dynamic range (HDR10, HDR10+ or HLG). The mark most TVs show; keep it unless your language spells it differently.

widgets.chips.dolby_vision.description: Chip shown for a few seconds in the corner of the picture when playback starts, and again when it changes: the picture is in Dolby Vision. A brand name; keep it as written.

widgets.chips.dolby_atmos.description: Chip shown for a few seconds in the corner of the picture when playback starts, and again when it changes: the sound is Dolby Atmos. A brand name; keep it as written.

widgets.chips.surround.description: Chip shown for a few seconds in the corner of the picture when playback starts, and again when it changes: the sound is surround. {layout} is its channel layout, such as 5.1 or 7.1. Keep it short: the chip holds about 30 characters.

widgets.chips.subtitles.description: Chip shown for a few seconds in the corner of the picture when playback starts, and again when it changes: the subtitles on screen. {language} is the subtitle track's language name as the server gives it, such as English. Keep it short: the chip holds about 30 characters.
